test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to Economic Survey Report of 2021-22, as on September 2021, what percentage of people have opted for ₹1,000 pension per month under the Atal Pension Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__78%__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• More people are opting for a pension amount of Rs **1,000 **per month, under the government-run** Atal Pension Yojana**** (APY)**.
 
• The scheme is gaining recognition amongst youngsters, consistent with the Economic Survey **2021-22.**
 
• The** flagship social protection scheme** of the authorities become released on **May 9, 2015,** to offer old-age profits security, mainly to the residents withinside the unorganized sectors. 
 
• On **September 2021**, around **78 percent** of subscribers opted for a **Rs 1,000** per month pension amount, as compared to **38 percent **of subscribers on **March 2016.**
 
• As many as eight in keeping with cent of the subscribers have opted for the pension subscription class of **Rs1,000/ 3,000/ 4,000 per month**, while **14 percent** have opted for a **Rs 5,000** per month pension.
 
• The** APY scheme** is being allotted through extra than 250 lively APY provider vendors which include all banks and publish offices.
 
• Citing the age-profile-related data of the **APY** subscribers, the Survey said, as, on **September 2021**, more than **43 percent** of subscribers have been between** 18 **and **25** years, in comparison to **29** in keeping with cent as on March 2016, suggesting growing enrolments at younger age. 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Orissa **are among the top states which have **APY** account enrolment of **10** lakhs and more.
